title: Enhancing Model Based Derivative Free Optimization using Direct Search
summary: We consider single and multiobjective simulation-based optimization problems. Simulation-based optimization has traditionally used both model-based and search-based methods, often in isolation. Model-based methods include trust region approaches and Bayesian optimization, while search methods include genetic algorithms and Direct Search-type techniques. In this work, we propose a switching framework that leverages Direct Search methods to enhance the performance of any model-based optimizer. Our contributions are twofold.
